organizations.title: Organization management
organizations.description: Invitations, active accounts, and suspended accounts
organizations.flowDescription: The network approves the organization list in a meeting, while the team reviews documents by email — formal registration is not required. The platform has no membership application or application review. Once approved, an invitation lets the organization create its own account.

steps.title: Approve the list
steps.description: A Hakima membership vote or team decision outside the platform

steps.title: Review documents
steps.description: By email; a commercial registry or formal registration is not required

steps.title: Send the invitation
steps.description: A one-time link opens organization account creation

steps.title: The organization creates its account
steps.description: It completes its profile and invites its own team

organizations.searchPlaceholder: Search by organization name or email
organizations.note: Suspending an account stops publishing and voting, but does not cancel existing obligations — ongoing exchanges continue and open cases remain open.

members.title: Member management
members.description: Individual accounts — organization teams and community members
members.searchPlaceholder: Search by name or username — example: rana.f
members.searchHint: Usernames are permanent, so they are more precise when names are repeated.
members.note: Suspending an individual stops requests, offers, mediation invitations, and arbitration invitations under their name — without affecting their organization account. Suspend the organization itself from organization management.
members.supportNote: Technical support reports and feedback are not managed here — find them in the team office inbox, assigned to their responsible person.

organizationInvite.title: Invite an organization
organizationInvite.description: Send a one-time registration link to the organization administrator
organizationInvite.formDescription: Enter the administrator’s name and email. They will complete the organization details when accepting the invitation.
organizationInvite.namePlaceholder: Name as it should appear on the network
organizationInvite.emailHint: This email is locked to the invitation and cannot be changed during registration.
organizationInvite.successDescription: We sent the link to {email}. It expires on {expiry}.
steps: The administrator receives a one-time registration link.
They create their account and enter the organization details.
The Emtedad team activates the account after review.
